text_en: Hear the word that the Lord speaks to you, O house of Israel.
text_cn: 以色列家！请听上主对你们说的话。

text_en: Thus says the Lord : Do not learn the way of the nations, or be dismayed at the signs of the heavens; for the nations are dismayed at them.
text_cn: 上主这样说：“你们不要学走异民的道路，不要畏惧天上的异兆：这是异民所畏惧的。

text_en: For the customs of the peoples are false: a tree from the forest is cut down, and worked with an ax by the hands of an artisan;
text_cn: 因为这些民族所敬畏的是“虚无”，是由森林砍来的树木，是匠人用斧制的作品，

text_en: people deck it with silver and gold; they fasten it with hammer and nails so that it cannot move.
text_cn: 装饰上金银，用铁钉铁锤钉住，叫它不动摇；

text_en: Their idols are like scarecrows in a cucumber field, and they cannot speak; they have to be carried, for they cannot walk. Do not be afraid of them, for they cannot do evil, nor is it in them to do good.
text_cn: 像胡瓜园里的草人，不能言语；常需要人搬运，不能行走；你们不要害怕，因为它不能害人，也不能施救。”

text_en: There is none like you, O Lord ; you are great, and your name is great in might.
text_cn: 上主，没有谁相似你；你是伟大的，你的名大有德能。

text_en: Who would not fear you, O King of the nations? For that is your due; among all the wise ones of the nations and in all their kingdoms there is no one like you.
text_cn: 万民的君王！谁能不敬畏你？这是你应得的，因为万民中所有的智者和他们所有的王国中，没有谁与你相似；

text_en: They are both stupid and foolish; the instruction given by idols is no better than wood!
text_cn: 他们全是愚昧无知。他们的教义全是虚伪不实，他们只不过是木偶；

text_en: Beaten silver is brought from Tarshish, and gold from Uphaz. They are the work of the artisan and of the hands of the goldsmith; their clothing is blue and purple; they are all the product of skilled workers.
text_cn: 是由塔尔史士采来的银打成的薄片，是由敖非尔采来的黄金，是艺人和银匠的制造品；穿的紫锦红衣，都是工匠的作品。

text_en: But the Lord is the true God; he is the living God and the everlasting King. At his wrath the earth quakes, and the nations cannot endure his indignation.
text_cn: 只有上主是真天主，是生活的天主，永远的君王；他一震怒，大地便战栗，万民都不能抵受他的忿怒。

text_en: Thus shall you say to them: The gods who did not make the heavens and the earth shall perish from the earth and from under the heavens.
text_cn: 【关于他们，你们应这样说：那未能创造天地的神祇，只有从地上天下消灭。】

text_en: It is he who made the earth by his power, who established the world by his wisdom, and by his understanding stretched out the heavens.
text_cn: 上主以自己的能力创造了大地，以自己的智慧奠定了寰宇，以自己的才智展布了诸天。

text_en: When he utters his voice, there is a tumult of waters in the heavens, and he makes the mist rise from the ends of the earth. He makes lightnings for the rain, and he brings out the wind from his storehouses.
text_cn: 他一声号令，使天上的水怒号，使云彩从地极上腾，使雷电霹雳造成豪雨，使暴风从他的仓库出发疾驰。

text_en: Everyone is stupid and without knowledge; goldsmiths are all put to shame by their idols; for their images are false, and there is no breath in them.
text_cn: 人都要自觉愚昧无知；每个银匠必因自己的雕像感到羞愧，因为所铸的像，只是“虚无”，没有气息；

text_en: They are worthless, a work of delusion; at the time of their punishment they shall perish.
text_cn: 是“虚无”，是愚弄人的作品；惩罚时期一到，它们都必要灭亡。

text_en: Not like these is the Lord , the portion of Jacob, for he is the one who formed all things, and Israel is the tribe of his inheritance; the Lord of hosts is his name.
text_cn: 那位作雅各伯产业的，与他们迥然不同，因为他是万物的造主，以色列是作他产业的支派，他的名字叫“万军的上主”。

text_en: Gather up your bundle from the ground, O you who live under siege!
text_cn: 你这被围困的城池，快从地上拾起你的行囊！

text_en: For thus says the Lord : I am going to sling out the inhabitants of the land at this time, and I will bring distress on them, so that they shall feel it.
text_cn: 因为上主这样说：“看， 这一次我必要远远抛弃这地的居民，磨难他们，使他们觉悟”。

text_en: Woe is me because of my hurt! My wound is severe. But I said, “Truly this is my punishment, and I must bear it. ”
text_cn: 唉我已遭破坏，我的创伤已不可治疗，但我仍想：这只不过是疾病，我还能忍受。

text_en: My tent is destroyed, and all my cords are broken; my children have gone from me, and they are no more; there is no one to spread my tent again, and to set up my curtains.
text_cn: 我的帐幕已破坏，我的绳索都已裂断，我的孩子全已离去，不复存在；再没有人支搭我的帐幕，张设我的帷幔。

text_en: For the shepherds are stupid, and do not inquire of the Lord ; therefore they have not prospered, and all their flock is scattered.
text_cn: 为民牧者既然愚蠢，不寻求上主，为此他们一事无成，羊群都已四散。

text_en: Hear, a noise! Listen, it is coming— a great commotion from the land of the north to make the cities of Judah a desolation, a lair of jackals.
text_cn: 听有个音讯传来：将有大骚动从北方而来，要使犹大的城邑荒凉，成为豺狼的巢穴。

text_en: I know, O Lord , that the way of human beings is not in their control, that mortals as they walk cannot direct their steps.
text_cn: 上主，我知道，人的道路是不由人的，行走的人也不能随便操纵自己的步伐。

text_en: Correct me, O Lord , but in just measure; not in your anger, or you will bring me to nothing.
text_cn: 上主，你惩戒我，只好按照正义，不要随你的忿怒，免得我归于乌有。

text_en: Pour out your wrath on the nations that do not know you, and on the peoples that do not call on your name; for they have devoured Jacob; they have devoured him and consumed him, and have laid waste his habitation.
text_cn: 愿你对不认识你的异民，和不呼求你名的宗族，发泄你的愤怒，因为他们并吞了雅各伯，毁灭破坏，蹂躏了她的住所。
